## CredentialUtils.checkValidEncoding() method

Check whether the raw value matches the encoded version according to the encoding format described in Aries RFC 0037 Use this method to ensure the received proof (over the encoded) value is the same as the raw value of the data.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
static checkValidEncoding(raw: unknown, encoded: string): boolean;
```
